task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the portable white fan and position it on the Brown mat, ensuring it faces the robot.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架抓住便携式白色风扇并将其放置在棕色垫子上，确保其面向机器人。
